title: Algebra 2: Rational Functions
tagline: Fractions grow up: simplify polynomial ratios, track forbidden inputs, read asymptotes and holes off a graph, and solve the equations they create.

chapters.title: Simplifying Rational Expressions
chapters.description: Excluded values, factoring-based simplification, and the restrictions that survive it — plus the (a − b)/(b − a) = −1 identity.

chapters.title: Multiplying & Dividing
chapters.description: Factor, cancel across, keep-change-flip, and track every exclusion — including the new bans a flip creates.

chapters.title: Adding & Subtracting
chapters.description: Combine like denominators, build polynomial LCDs factor-by-factor, and run the full unlike-denominator pipeline with the minus fully distributed.

chapters.title: Graphs: Asymptotes & Holes
chapters.description: The reciprocal parent and its guide rails, the 0/0 signature that separates holes from walls, and horizontal asymptotes by degree comparison.

chapters.title: Rational Equations & Variation
chapters.description: Clear the LCD, filter out phantom candidates, cross-multiply proportions, add work rates, and run the two-step k ritual for inverse and joint variation.
